name: summoning-seal-materialise
intent: Draw-stroke a radial seal (outer then inner), snap ticks, then expand a tool panel from the seal centre via clip/scale — not fade.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Seal fully drawn and panel materialised immediately; no draw or expand motion

acceptance: Outer ring draw-stroke completes in ringOuterMs 300 before inner ring starts (ringInnerMs 260)
Eight ticks scale in after inner ring; panel remains clip-path circle(0%) until seal complete
Panel expands from seal centre via clip-path + scale 0.2→1 over panelMs 300 (not opacity)
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows MATERIALISED immediately
